mentions.name: Aucly
mentions.description: An online auction platform for schools, charities, and similar organizations that lets them run fundraising auctions without exploitative transaction fees.
mentions.problem: Existing auction platforms charge exploitative transaction fees that cut into funds raised by schools and charities.
mentions.audience: Schools, charities, and similar organizations running fundraising auctions, such as parent-teacher associations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're building Aucly: https://aucly.co.uk/

It's an auction website for schools, charities etc without the exploitative transaction fees.
